## Release Drafter Metadata

- [ ] The PR title uses `type(optional-scope): summary`.
- [ ] Each commit uses the same Conventional Commit format.
- [ ] I selected a `security` / `security-fix` label for a security fix.
- [ ] I selected a `breaking-change` / `major` label for an intentional major release.
- [ ] I did not use `skip-changelog`, or I have maintainer approval to exclude this change.

See [the release workflow](../docs/RELEASE_WORKFLOW.md) for the required types,
labels, automated validation, and manual publishing checklist.
